P9926: Rivalry in piling up more distracts you until you visit the graves. No, you will come to know; again, you will come to know. If only you knew with certainty: you will surely see the blazing fire, see it with the eye of certainty, and then on that day be questioned about the comforts you enjoyed.
P4566: Was there not a time when man was nothing worth mention? God made him from a mingled drop to test him, gave him hearing and sight, and showed him the way, grateful or ungrateful. Chains, shackles and a blaze await deniers; the righteous drink a camphor-mixed cup from a gushing spring, keep vows and fear a day of widespread evil.
P7410: God's command is coming, so do not hurry it; He is far above their partner-gods. He sends angels with the spirit to chosen servants to warn that He alone is god. He made heavens and earth, and man from a drop, who openly disputes. Livestock give warmth, food, beauty at evening and morning, and carry loads to distant lands.
P1334: Deniers among scripture-holders and idolaters would not desist until clear proof came: a messenger from God reciting purified pages of upright writings. Scripture-holders split only after that proof, though commanded only to worship God sincerely, pray and give alms, which is the upright religion. Such deniers stay forever in hellfire, the worst of creatures.
P9413: Everything in heavens and earth glorifies God, who holds kingship, praise and all power. He created you, some denying and some believing, and sees your deeds. He shaped you well, and all return to Him. He knows what you hide and show, even hearts' secrets. Has news not reached you of earlier deniers who tasted the consequence?
P2422: A command to say: I seek refuge with the Lord of daybreak from the evil of what He created, from the evil of darkness when it settles in, from the evil of those who blow on knots, and from the evil of an envier when he envies.
P8573: Oaths by those ranged in rows, those who drive back, those reciting a reminder: your God is one, Lord of heavens, earth and the sunrises. The nearest sky is adorned with stars and guarded from devils, who cannot overhear the high assembly and are pelted and chased by piercing flame. Ask: are they harder to create, made from sticky clay?
P6907: Oaths by a mountain, a book written on unrolled parchment, a frequented house, the raised roof and the swollen sea: your Lord's punishment will fall, unstoppable, when sky sways and mountains move. Woe to deniers playing in idle talk, shoved into the fire they denied and asked: is this magic? Endure or not, you are repaid for your deeds.
P1042: This scripture, beyond doubt, guides the mindful, who believe in the unseen, pray, spend from their provision, accept revelations past and present, and are sure of the hereafter. Deniers will not believe whether warned or not; their hearts and hearing are sealed, their eyes veiled. Some falsely claim faith, trying to deceive God and believers but deceiving only themselves.
P7071: These are verses of a clear scripture in its hearers' language; the best of stories is told to one formerly unaware. A son tells his father he dreamed eleven stars, sun and moon bowing to him. The father warns him not to tell his brothers lest they plot; God will choose him, teach him interpretation and complete His favour.
P2600: Oaths by dawn, ten nights, the even and the odd, and the passing night. See how your Lord dealt with a people of unmatched lofty pillars, a people who carved valley rock, and a ruler of stakes, tyrants spreading corruption: He poured a scourge on them; He is watchful. Man, tested with honour and ease, says his Lord honoured him.
P5366: Believers must not put themselves ahead of God and His messenger, nor raise their voices above the prophet's or address him loudly as they do each other, lest their deeds be voided unawares. Those lowering their voices near him have hearts proven pious and gain forgiveness and great reward. Most who shout to him from outside the rooms lack sense.
P2501: From the Merciful, a scripture of detailed verses in its hearers' language, giving good news and warning, yet most turn away, saying their hearts are covered, their ears deaf, a veil between; act, as we will. Reply: I am only human, inspired that your god is one; go straight to Him. Woe to idolaters withholding alms and denying the hereafter.
P3912: A prophet is asked why he forbids himself what God allowed, to please his wives; oaths may be released. He confided in a wife; she disclosed it; God informed him; he raised part, saying the All-Knowing told him. Two women should repent, their hearts swerved; if they unite against him, God, an angel, righteous believers and angels support him.
P3701: People's reckoning nears while they turn away heedless, hearing each new reminder while playing. Wrongdoers whisper: is he not merely human like you; will you accept sorcery open-eyed? He says his Lord knows every word in heaven and earth. They call it muddled dreams, invention, poetry, and demand a sign like earlier messengers'. No town destroyed earlier believed; will they?
P2599: When the sun is folded, stars dim, mountains move, pregnant camels abandoned, beasts herded, seas boil, souls paired, the buried infant girl asked for what sin she was killed, records opened, sky stripped, hell stoked and paradise brought near, each soul knows what it brought. By the hiding stars, departing night and breathing dawn: this is a noble messenger's word.
P6483: A command to tell the deniers: I do not worship what you worship, and you do not worship what I worship; I will never worship what you have worshipped, nor will you worship what I worship. You have your religion and I have mine.
P2681: By the clear scripture: sent down on a blessed night as warning, when every wise matter is decided by divine command, a mercy from the Lord of heavens and earth, the only god, who gives life and death, Lord of you and your forefathers. Yet they play in doubt. So watch for the day the sky brings visible smoke.
P9944: Believers must not befriend God's enemy and theirs, who rejected the truth and expelled the messenger and them for believing. If you set out striving for Me, why secretly show them affection, when I know what you hide and reveal? Doing so is straying. Given the upper hand, they would harm you by hand and tongue and wish you disbelieved.
P3919: These are scripture's verses; what is revealed to you is truth, though most disbelieve. God raised the heavens without visible pillars, took the throne, and set sun and moon running to a fixed term, so you may be sure of meeting Him. He spread the earth, placed mountains, rivers and paired fruits, and covers day with night: signs for thinkers.
P5865: A prophet was sent to warn his people before a painful punishment. He said: worship God, fear Him, obey me; He will forgive you and grant respite until an undelayable fixed term. He told his Lord: I called them night and day, which only drove them away; they put fingers in their ears, covered themselves with clothes, persisting arrogantly.
P2267: By the pen and what they write: you are not mad, by your Lord's grace; you have unending reward and great character. You and they will see who is afflicted. Do not yield to deniers, who want mutual compromise, nor obey any contemptible oath-monger, slanderer, tale-bearer, hinderer of good, sinful, coarse and base, just because he has wealth and sons.
P5580: A command to say: I seek refuge with the Lord of humankind, the King of humankind, the God of humankind, from the evil of the whisperer who slinks away, who whispers into people's hearts, whether from among unseen beings or from among humans.
P5387: He frowned and turned away when the blind man came, who might have been purified or reminded. You attend to the self-satisfied yet neglect one who came eager and fearful. A reminder for whoever wills, in honoured pure pages held by noble scribes. Ruin to ungrateful man: made from a drop, proportioned, his path eased, then dead and buried.
P4679: Oaths by those sent in succession, storming violently, scattering widely, separating, and delivering a reminder as excuse or warning: the promise will happen. When stars are blotted out, the sky split, mountains blown away and the messengers' time fixed, comes the day of sorting. Woe then to deniers. Earlier peoples were destroyed, later ones follow; so the guilty are treated.
P9620: Woe to every backbiter and fault-finder who gathers wealth and counts it, thinking his wealth will make him last forever. No: he will be flung into the crusher. And what is the crusher? It is God's kindled fire that reaches up over the hearts, closed in upon them in extended columns.
P2208: This scripture comes from God, mighty and wise, in truth; worship Him sincerely, for pure devotion is His alone. Those taking other patrons say they worship them only to get nearer to God; God will judge their disputes and guides no lying ingrate. Had God wanted a child, He could have chosen from His creation; He is One, Overpowering.
P6144: A prophet is told to fear God, not obey deniers and hypocrites, follow revelation and trust God as guardian. God has not put two hearts in any man, nor made wives you liken to your mothers into your mothers, nor made those you call sons your real sons. Those are mere words of your mouths; God speaks truth and guides.
P1687: Woe to short-measurers, who take full measure from others but give less when measuring or weighing for them. Do they not expect raising on a great day to stand before the Lord? The wicked's record is in a prison-register, an inscribed book. Woe to deniers of judgement day calling the verses ancient fables; their earnings have rusted their hearts.
P4641: Verses of the wise scripture. Is it strange one of them was inspired to warn and promise believers sure standing? Deniers say: a sorcerer. Your Lord made heavens and earth in six days, took the throne, directs all; none intercedes without His leave. All return to Him; He begins and repeats creation to reward the righteous; deniers get scalding drink.
P3019: This scripture comes from God, mighty and wise. In heavens and earth are signs for believers; in your creation and the creatures He scatters, signs for the certain; in alternating night and day, the provision from the sky reviving dead earth, and the shifting winds, signs for the reasoning. In what message after God and His signs will they believe?
P7983: Praise to God, originator of heavens and earth, who makes angels messengers with two, three or four wings, adding to creation as He wills. Mercy God opens none can withhold; what He withholds none can release. People, remember God's favour: does any creator besides God provide for you from sky and earth? No god but Him; so why turn away?
P7905: Say: I was told that some unseen beings listened and said: we heard a wondrous recitation guiding to right conduct; we believe and will join no partner to our Lord, who has no spouse or child. Our fool spoke outrageously about God, though we thought none would lie about Him. Men seeking refuge with our kind only increased the burden.
P5968: Praise to God, who sent the scripture to His servant without crookedness, to warn of severe punishment, promise good-doing believers a lasting reward, and warn those who say God has taken a child, a monstrous baseless lie. Perhaps you will destroy yourself with grief over their unbelief. What is on earth was made its adornment to test who acts best.
P5527: By the glorious recitation: they marvel that one of their own came warning, saying: once dead and dust, a far-fetched return! We know what earth consumes of them and keep a record. Denying truth, they are confused. Have they not seen the sky above, built and adorned without rift, and the earth spread, set with mountains, growing every lovely kind?
P3880: Asked about war spoils, say they belong to God and the messenger, so fear God, mend relations and obey. True believers' hearts tremble at God's mention and their faith grows on hearing His verses; they trust Him, pray and spend, gaining ranks, forgiveness and generous provision. Likewise your Lord rightly brought you from your home, though some believers were unwilling.
P1389: Do people think saying they believe spares them testing? Earlier people were tested, so God will know truthful from liars. Do evildoers think they can outrun Us? Whoever hopes to meet God: His term is coming. Whoever strives, strives for himself; God needs nothing from the worlds. Good-doing believers will have misdeeds erased and be repaid by their best deeds.
P1988: God and His messenger renounce obligations to idolaters you had treaties with: move freely for four months, knowing you cannot escape God. Proclaimed on the great pilgrimage day: both disown the idolaters; repenting is better; turning away will not frustrate God. Excepted are those who kept their treaty fully and aided no one against you; honour it to its term.
P7757: This recitation came not to distress you but to remind the fearful, from earth and heaven's Creator, the Merciful enthroned, owning all above, below and underground, who knows secrets and things more hidden, with the finest names. Then a story: a man saw a fire and told his family to wait while he sought a brand or guidance.
P5026: We sent it down on the night of decree. What will make you grasp what the night of decree is? It is better than a thousand months. In it the angels and the spirit descend, by their Lord's permission, with every matter. It is peace until the rising of dawn.
P6018: The hour nears and the moon has split. Yet seeing a sign they turn away, call it lasting sorcery and follow their whims. Deterring tidings and far-reaching wisdom have come, but warnings fail. Turn from them. When the caller summons to something dreadful, they leave graves with lowered eyes like scattered locusts, hurrying to him; deniers say: a hard day.
P7188: For the accustomed security of a tribe, their being accustomed to the winter and summer journeys, let them worship the Lord of this house, who has fed them against hunger and made them safe from fear.
P8942: Someone asked about a punishment sure to befall deniers, unstoppable, from God of the ascents, to whom angels and the spirit rise in a day of fifty thousand years. Be gracefully patient; they see it far, We see it near. That day sky resembles molten metal, mountains like wool, friend ignores friend; the guilty would ransom himself with his children.
P9425: Verses of the clear scripture. Perhaps you grieve yourself to death over their unbelief. If We willed, a sign from heaven would bow their necks. They shun every new reminder and will learn what they mocked. Do they not see how many noble kinds earth grows? A sign, yet most disbelieve. Your Lord told a prophet: go to the wrongdoers.
P4388: Oaths by those that scatter, bear loads, glide easily and apportion a command: the promise is true and judgement will come. By the sky of woven paths, your views conflict. Cursed are heedless guessers asking when judgement comes: when they are tried over fire and told to taste what they hurried. The mindful, former good-doers, are among gardens and springs.
P6985: Believers have succeeded: humble in prayer, shunning idle talk, giving alms, guarding chastity except with spouses or those they possess, keeping trusts and pledges, guarding prayers. They inherit paradise forever. Man was made from clay extract, then a drop safely lodged, a clinging clot, a lump, bones clothed with flesh, then another creation; blessed is God, best of creators.
P9599: The striking calamity: what is it, and what will make you grasp it? A day when people are like scattered moths and the mountains like carded wool. Whoever's scales weigh heavy will have a pleasing life; whoever's scales are light, the pit is his mother. And what is that? A raging fire.
P8428: The inevitable: what is it? Two peoples denied the striking calamity. One perished by an overwhelming blast, the other by a furious wind across seven nights, eight days, felling them like hollow palm trunks, no remnant. A ruler, his predecessors and the overturned towns defied their Lord's messenger and were seized hard. When water overflowed, We carried you by ship.
P1341: When the sky splits and obeys its Lord, and the flattened earth empties itself and obeys: human, you toil toward your Lord and will meet Him. Whoever gets his record in his right hand has an easy reckoning and returns home happy. Whoever receives it behind his back will cry for ruin and burn; he lived happily, expecting no return.
P9718: An empire was defeated in the nearest land, but will prevail within a few years. The decision is God's before and after; that day believers will rejoice in God's help. God's promise never fails, though most know only worldly life's surface and neglect the hereafter. Have they not reflected that God made heavens and earth truly, for a set term?
P3089: A chapter sent down as binding, with clear verses. The woman and man guilty of illicit sex each get a hundred lashes, without pity, before believing witnesses. Such a man marries only such a woman or an idolatress, and likewise she; forbidden to believers. Accusers of chaste women who lack four witnesses get eighty lashes and permanent rejection as witnesses.
P7553: Read in your Lord's name, who created man from a clot; most generous, He taught by the pen what man knew not. Man oversteps, deeming himself self-sufficient, yet all return to your Lord. Consider one who forbids a praying servant who may be guided. Does he not know God sees? If he persists, his lying, sinful forelock will be seized.
P8276: By this city where you live, by parent and child: man was created in hardship. Does he think none can overpower or see him, boasting of squandered wealth? Given eyes, tongue, lips and the two ways, he shuns the steep path: freeing slaves, or feeding, in famine, orphaned kin or dust-bound poor, then joining believers urging patience and compassion.
P4738: By the reminding recitation: deniers are proud and defiant. Many earlier generations perished, crying out too late. Amazed that one of them warns, they call him a lying sorcerer: has he made the gods one god? Their chiefs say: hold to your gods; this is a scheme, unheard of, invented; why him among us? They have not yet tasted punishment.
P6311: Verses of the recitation, a clear book, guide and gladden believers who pray, give alms and trust the hereafter. Deniers of the hereafter, their deeds made attractive, wander blindly, the greatest losers. A man told his family he saw fire and would bring news or a warming brand; arriving, he heard: blessed are those in and around the fire.
P9820: We granted you a clear victory, that God may forgive your past and future faults, complete His favour, guide you straight and help you mightily. He sent tranquillity into believers' hearts to deepen their faith; heaven and earth's forces are His. He will admit believing men and women to river-fed gardens forever and erase their misdeeds, a great triumph.
P2133: Have you seen the one who denies the judgement? He is the one who pushes the orphan away and does not urge the feeding of the poor. Woe, then, to those who pray yet are heedless of their prayer, who act only to be seen, and who withhold small kindnesses.
